#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>

__constant__ __half c_weight[COUT * CIN * 3 * 3];
__constant__ __half c_bias[COUT];

void set_conv_params(const __half* weight, const __half* bias) {
    cudaMemcpyToSymbol(c_weight, weight, sizeof(__half) * COUT * CIN * 3 * 3);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbol(c_bias, bias, sizeof(__half) * COUT);
}

__global__ void fused_conv_relu_pool_kernel(const __half* __restrict__ input,
                                             __half* __restrict__ output) {
    __shared__ __half smem_in[CIN][TILE_IN_H][TILE_IN_W];

    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
    const int tid = ty * TILE_OUT_W + tx;
    const int nthreads = TILE_OUT_W * TILE_OUT_H;

    const int out_x0 = blockIdx.x * TILE_OUT_W;
    const int out_y0 = blockIdx.y * TILE_OUT_H;
    const int conv_x0 = out_x0 * 2;
    const int conv_y0 = out_y0 * 2;
    const int in_x0 = conv_x0 - 1;
    const int in_y0 = conv_y0 - 1;

    const int tile_pixels = TILE_IN_H * TILE_IN_W;
    #pragma unroll 1
    for (int idx = tid; idx < tile_pixels; idx += nthreads) {
        int ly = idx / TILE_IN_W;
        int lx = idx - ly * TILE_IN_W;
        int gy = in_y0 + ly;
        int gx = in_x0 + lx;
        bool in_bounds = (gy >= 0 && gy < H_IN && gx >= 0 && gx < W_IN);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int c = 0; c < CIN; ++c) {
            __half v = __float2half(0.0f);
            if (in_bounds) {
                v = input[((c) * H_IN + gy) * W_IN + gx];
            }
            smem_in[c][ly][lx] = v;
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    const int cy0 = 1 + 2 * ty;
    const int cx0 = 1 + 2 * tx;

    const int gx_out = out_x0 + tx;
    const int gy_out = out_y0 + ty;
    if (gx_out >= W_OUT || gy_out >= H_OUT) return;

    #pragma unroll 1
    for (int oc = 0; oc < COUT; ++oc) {
        float acc00 = 0.f, acc01 = 0.f, acc10 = 0.f, acc11 = 0.f;

        const __half* w_oc = &c_weight[oc * CIN * 9];

        #pragma unroll
        for (int c = 0; c < CIN; ++c) {
            const __half* w = w_oc + c * 9;
            float patch[4][4];
            #pragma unroll
            for (int dy = 0; dy < 4; ++dy) {
                #pragma unroll
                for (int dx = 0; dx < 4; ++dx) {
                    patch[dy][dx] = __half2float(smem_in[c][cy0 - 1 + dy][cx0 - 1 + dx]);
                }
            }
            float wf[9];
            #pragma unroll
            for (int i = 0; i < 9; ++i) wf[i] = __half2float(w[i]);

            #pragma unroll
            for (int py = 0; py < 2; ++py) {
                #pragma unroll
                for (int px = 0; px < 2; ++px) {
                    float s = 0.f;
                    #pragma unroll
                    for (int ky = 0; ky < 3; ++ky) {
                        #pragma unroll
                        for (int kx = 0; kx < 3; ++kx) {
                            s += patch[py + ky][px + kx] * wf[ky * 3 + kx];
                        }
                    }
                    if (py == 0 && px == 0) acc00 += s;
                    else if (py == 0 && px == 1) acc01 += s;
                    else if (py == 1 && px == 0) acc10 += s;
                    else acc11 += s;
                }
            }
        }

        float b = __half2float(c_bias[oc]);
        float v00 = fmaxf(acc00 + b, 0.f);
        float v01 = fmaxf(acc01 + b, 0.f);
        float v10 = fmaxf(acc10 + b, 0.f);
        float v11 = fmaxf(acc11 + b, 0.f);
        float pooled = (v00 + v01 + v10 + v11) * 0.25f;

        output[((oc) * H_OUT + gy_out) * W_OUT + gx_out] = __float2half(pooled);
    }
}

void launch_fused_conv_relu_pool(const __half* input, __half* output, cudaStream_t stream) {
    dim3 block(TILE_OUT_W, TILE_OUT_H);
    dim3 grid((W_OUT + TILE_OUT_W - 1) / TILE_OUT_W,
              (H_OUT + TILE_OUT_H - 1) / TILE_OUT_H);
    fused_conv_relu_pool_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(input, output);
}

#include <cuda_fp16.h>

#include "kernel.h"

    TORCH_CHECK(bias.is_cuda(), "bias must be CUDA");

    cudaStream_t stream = c10::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream();

    launch_fused_conv_relu_pool(

        stream
    );

#include "kernel.h"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>

// Weight layout: [CIN][9][COUT] for contiguous half2 loads across oc pairs.
__constant__ __half c_weight[CIN * 9 * COUT];
__constant__ __half c_bias[COUT];

void set_conv_params(const __half* weight, const __half* bias) {
    // Original weight layout: [COUT][CIN][3][3]
    // Reorder to [CIN][9][COUT]
    __half h_w[CIN * 9 * COUT];
    __half tmp[COUT * CIN * 9];
    cudaMemcpy(tmp, weight, sizeof(__half) * COUT * CIN * 9, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);
    for (int oc = 0; oc < COUT; ++oc) {
        for (int c = 0; c < CIN; ++c) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 9; ++k) {
                h_w[(c * 9 + k) * COUT + oc] = tmp[(oc * CIN + c) * 9 + k];
            }
        }
    }
    cudaMemcpyToSymbol(c_weight, h_w, sizeof(__half) * CIN * 9 * COUT);
    cudaMemcpyToSymbol(c_bias, bias, sizeof(__half) * COUT);
}

#define COUT_H2 (COUT / 2)  // 16

__global__ void fused_conv_relu_pool_kernel(const __half* __restrict__ input,
                                             __half* __restrict__ output) {
    __shared__ __half smem_in[CIN][TILE_IN_H][TILE_IN_W];

    const int tx = threadIdx.x;
    const int ty = threadIdx.y;
    const int tid = ty * TILE_OUT_W + tx;
    const int nthreads = TILE_OUT_W * TILE_OUT_H;

    const int out_x0 = blockIdx.x * TILE_OUT_W;
    const int out_y0 = blockIdx.y * TILE_OUT_H;
    const int conv_x0 = out_x0 * 2;
    const int conv_y0 = out_y0 * 2;
    const int in_x0 = conv_x0 - 1;
    const int in_y0 = conv_y0 - 1;

    const int tile_pixels = TILE_IN_H * TILE_IN_W;
    #pragma unroll 1
    for (int idx = tid; idx < tile_pixels; idx += nthreads) {
        int ly = idx / TILE_IN_W;
        int lx = idx - ly * TILE_IN_W;
        int gy = in_y0 + ly;
        int gx = in_x0 + lx;
        bool in_bounds = (gy >= 0 && gy < H_IN && gx >= 0 && gx < W_IN);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int c = 0; c < CIN; ++c) {
            __half v = __float2half(0.0f);
            if (in_bounds) {
                v = input[((c) * H_IN + gy) * W_IN + gx];
            }
            smem_in[c][ly][lx] = v;
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    const int cy0 = 1 + 2 * ty;
    const int cx0 = 1 + 2 * tx;

    const int gx_out = out_x0 + tx;
    const int gy_out = out_y0 + ty;
    bool valid = (gx_out < W_OUT && gy_out < H_OUT);

    // Accumulators: per output channel pair (half2), per pool position
    __half2 acc00[COUT_H2];
    __half2 acc01[COUT_H2];
    __half2 acc10[COUT_H2];
    __half2 acc11[COUT_H2];

    const __half2 zero2 = __float2half2_rn(0.0f);
    #pragma unroll
    for (int o = 0; o < COUT_H2; ++o) {
        acc00[o] = zero2;
        acc01[o] = zero2;
        acc10[o] = zero2;
        acc11[o] = zero2;
    }

    // Loop over input channels and 3x3 kernel positions
    #pragma unroll
    for (int c = 0; c < CIN; ++c) {
        // Load 4x4 patch from shared memory once
        __half patch[4][4];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int dy = 0; dy < 4; ++dy) {
            #pragma unroll
            for (int dx = 0; dx < 4; ++dx) {
                patch[dy][dx] = smem_in[c][cy0 - 1 + dy][cx0 - 1 + dx];
            }
        }

        // For each kernel position, multiply across all output channel pairs
        #pragma unroll
        for (int ky = 0; ky < 3; ++ky) {
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kx = 0; kx < 3; ++kx) {
                int k = ky * 3 + kx;
                const __half2* w_ptr = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&c_weight[(c * 9 + k) * COUT]);

                // Build half2 broadcasts of the 4 patch values needed
                __half2 p00 = __half2half2(patch[ky + 0][kx + 0]);
                __half2 p01 = __half2half2(patch[ky + 0][kx + 1]);
                __half2 p10 = __half2half2(patch[ky + 1][kx + 0]);
                __half2 p11 = __half2half2(patch[ky + 1][kx + 1]);

                // patch indices for the 4 pool positions:
                // pool(0,0): py=0,px=0 -> patch[ky][kx]
                // pool(0,1): py=0,px=1 -> patch[ky][kx+1]
                // pool(1,0): py=1,px=0 -> patch[ky+1][kx]
                // pool(1,1): py=1,px=1 -> patch[ky+1][kx+1]

                #pragma unroll
                for (int o = 0; o < COUT_H2; ++o) {
                    __half2 w = w_ptr[o];
                    acc00[o] = __hfma2(w, p00, acc00[o]);
                    acc01[o] = __hfma2(w, p01, acc01[o]);
                    acc10[o] = __hfma2(w, p10, acc10[o]);
                    acc11[o] = __hfma2(w, p11, acc11[o]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (!valid) return;

    const __half2 quarter = __float2half2_rn(0.25f);
    const __half2 zero_h2 = __float2half2_rn(0.0f);

    #pragma unroll
    for (int o = 0; o < COUT_H2; ++o) {
        __half2 b = *reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(&c_bias[o * 2]);
        __half2 v00 = __hmax2(__hadd2(acc00[o], b), zero_h2);
        __half2 v01 = __hmax2(__hadd2(acc01[o], b), zero_h2);
        __half2 v10 = __hmax2(__hadd2(acc10[o], b), zero_h2);
        __half2 v11 = __hmax2(__hadd2(acc11[o], b), zero_h2);
        __half2 sum = __hadd2(__hadd2(v00, v01), __hadd2(v10, v11));
        __half2 pooled = __hmul2(sum, quarter);

        int oc0 = o * 2;
        output[((oc0)     * H_OUT + gy_out) * W_OUT + gx_out] = __low2half(pooled);
        output[((oc0 + 1) * H_OUT + gy_out) * W_OUT + gx_out] = __high2half(pooled);
    }
}

void launch_fused_conv_relu_pool(const __half* input, __half* output, cudaStream_t stream) {
    dim3 block(TILE_OUT_W, TILE_OUT_H);
    dim3 grid((W_OUT + TILE_OUT_W - 1) / TILE_OUT_W,
              (H_OUT + TILE_OUT_H - 1) / TILE_OUT_H);
    fused_conv_relu_pool_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(input, output);
}

                for (int o = 0; o < COUT_H2; ++o) {

                __half2 p10 = __half2half2(patch[ky + 1][kx + 0]);
                __half2 p11 = __half2half2(patch[ky + 1][kx + 1]);
